defs.def: located above sth else, especially sth of the same type or the other of a pair 上边的，上面的，上层的（尤指同类或一对中的一个）

ex.s: They had fewer upper teeth than lower teeth.
During the training stage, each dog was shown only the upper half or the lower half of the person’s face.
ex.t: 在训练阶段，每只狗只被展示了人脸的上半部分或下半部分。

ex.s: This builds strength in your upper body, especially in your arms and back.
ex.t: 这在你的上身 特别是你的手臂和背部 建立了力量

ex.s: In most countries, the average age for starting university is 18 years old, but actually there is no upper age limit for starting a university degree.
ex.t: 在大多数国家，上大学的平均年龄是18岁，但实际上开始大学学位并没有年龄上限。

ex.s: The American ambassador to Britain invited Henry to an upper-class party.
ex.t: 美国驻英国大使邀请亨利参加一场上流社会的派对。

ex.s: After out the assistant, he asked to see an expensive-looking suit on an upper shelf.
ex.t: 打发走店员后，他要求看一件放在高架子上、看似昂贵的西装。

defs.def: at or near the top of sth 上部的；靠上部的

ex.s: Make a fist with one hand and place it in the upper part of his stomach.
ex.t: 用一只手握拳，放在他的上腹部。

defs.def: located away from the coast, on high ground or towards the north of an area 地方
the top part of a shoe that is attached to the sole 鞋帮；靴面
a drug that makes you feel excited and full of energy 兴奋剂

chunks.en: upper age / part / body / half / shelf
chunks.cn: 上边的年龄 / 上边的部分 / 上边的身体 / 上边的一半 / 上边的固定在墙上的或橱
